notifications.title: Admission Form 2026-27 is now open
notifications.body: Applications for the 2026-27 session are being accepted. Limited seats available across classes.

notifications.title: Registration open for MUST 2026
notifications.body: Max Ultimate Scholarship Test 2026 on 15th, 22nd and 29th March. Scholarships up to 90% on tuition fee, in partnership with Physics Wallah Vidyapeeth.

notifications.title: Manali educational trip concluded
notifications.body: Students returned from a five-day excursion to Manali. Photographs from all five days are now up in the gallery.

notifications.title: Inter-house Speech Competition held
notifications.body: The annual speech competition saw participation across all houses, with awards for content, delivery and confidence.

notifications.title: International Yoga Day celebrated
notifications.body: Students and faculty took part in a campus-wide yoga session, followed by a talk on daily discipline and wellbeing.
